name: comp-112
blurb: Preview text button paired with an external link icon button.
description: Two grouped outline buttons: 'Preview' text and an 'Open link' icon. Grouped with negative margins and rounded edges.
use_when: Offering both a preview and an open-in-new-tab action for links or content.
avoid_when: When buttons should trigger different actions or have different styles.
a11y: Uses aria-label on the icon button and aria-hidden on the icon.
